t: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to any Vice President holding office on or after the date of enactment of the Act.

fable.w: This is an applicability/effective-date provision stating to whom the Act's amendments apply. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government; the only actor mentioned is the Vice President, a federal official. There is no real tempting reading toward participation here.
fable.s: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to any Vice President holding office on or after the date of enactment of the Act.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard applicability clause that defines the temporal scope of the Act's amendments. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or input from outside parties (such as the public, states, or experts) before a federal decision is made. The Vice President is a federal official, and the text merely states when the law applies to them, not how they participate in decision-making.
qwen_block.s: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to any Vice President holding office on or after the date of enactment of the Act.

opus.w: This section only sets when the Act's amendments take effect: they apply to any Vice President in office on or after the enactment date. There is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. Nothing in the text could be mistaken for participation, so the label is clearly No.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard applicability clause that defines the temporal scope of the amendments. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. It merely states that the new rules apply to Vice Presidents in office after the enactment date.
qwen_chat.s: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to any Vice President holding office on or after the date of enactment of the Act.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the Act amends laws regarding the Vice President, it implicitly involves public participation or consultation. However, the text itself is merely a temporal applicability clause ("shall apply with respect to..."). It does not describe any process of consultation, hearing, comment period, or advisory board. It simply states when the new rules take effect. There is no interaction with outside parties described in this specific section.
